title: Reduced-monomial dimension bound for the p-root quotient
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $p>0$, $n\ge0$ and $a:\operatorname{Fin}n\to k$. The actual quotient $Q=k[X_i]/(X_i^p-a_i)$ [lem-weil-pbc-pth-root-algebra-local] is a finite-dimensional $k$-vector space, and $\operatorname{finrank}_k Q\le p^n$. No characteristic or differential independence is assumed.

source.place: Tag 07E5, proof of (2) => (4), first paragraph; Algebra 07DZ; monic division for the reduced-monomial bound. Read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07E5 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07DZ (local checkout absent).

proof.text: Use the actual quotient map q, whose defining relations give q(X_i)^p=a_i. For an exponent vector e put r_i=e_i mod p. The monomial formula and the identity e_i=p*(e_i/p)+r_i show that q(C(c)X^e)=(c*prod_i a_i^(e_i/p)) times prod_i q(X_i)^r_i. Each polynomial is a finite sum of these monomials, so the span of the family m indexed by Fin n -> Fin p is top. Fintype.linearCombination k m is surjective, proving Module.Finite. The surjective linear-map finrank inequality and the card of Fin n -> Fin p prove finrank <= p^n. This is a direct elementary calculation using quotient relations, exponent division and finite sums/products; it does not use monic-quotient freeness.

theorem pthRootAlgebra_finite_finrank_le
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (p n : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (a : Fin n → k) :
    Module.Finite k (pthRootAlgebra p n k a) ∧
      Module.finrank k (pthRootAlgebra p n k a) ≤ p ^ n
